subject: Operations
title: Supply Chain Visibility
description: A micro-lesson that makes Supply Chain Visibility usable.

hook.text: A shipment is lost between Mumbai and London. Nobody knows where it is. That's a visibility failure.

buildup.text: Supply chain visibility means knowing the status, location, and condition of every order, shipment, and inventory item.

discovery.text: It requires connected systems across partners—sharing real-time data on orders, transit, and stock levels.

twist.text: Most companies have visibility within their walls but not across partners. The chain is as clear as its weakest link.

climax.text: Control towers aggregate data from all supply chain partners into one real-time dashboard for end-to-end visibility.

punchline.text: You can't manage what you can't see. See everything.

quiz.question: What is a supply chain control tower?
options: A dashboard aggregating data from all partners
